value_differences.gold_value: A model that misses the new competing-cause branch has stopped too early. A model that rewrites the preserved sibling branch without contrary evidence has over-revised.
value_differences.model_value: Under-revision failure: failing to weaken edge:primary_support or omitting edge:alternate_support and unknown:dominant_cause would ignore the inserted alternate-cause pressure. Over-revision failure: revising state:secondary, edge:secondary_support, or unknown:secondary would incorrectly disturb the independently supported preserve_branch, which has no contrary evidence introduced against it.
